claim_scores.rationale: Creates `orig = Embeddings(...)` with explicit `k`, `normalize`, corpus, then calls `orig.save(path)`, which saves config and corpus embeddings.
Constructs separate `fresh = Embeddings(...)` with conflicting settings and calls `fresh.load(path, embedder)` on that instance.
Asserts `fresh.k == 2`, `fresh.normalize is False`, and `fresh.corpus == corpus`, proving loaded disk config overwrote constructor values.
Queries both retrievers with the same input and asserts identical `passages` and `indices`, showing preserved retrieval behavior after load.
